# Doctoral Research in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence

*Statistical and experimental investigation of learned structure, probabilistic behavior and emergent regularities in Large Language Models.*

Universidad El Bosque · Claudio de la Rosa

Este sitio es un **Doctoral Research Hub / Computational Research Journal / Reproducible LLM Laboratory**: documenta la formación doctoral y, con especial rigor, el desarrollo de la tesis *Embedded Intelligence: Inheritance and Resurgence Across Large Language Models* (título provisional).
